evidence_types.artifact: Sanitized request/response transcript with operation ID, status, request ID
Scoped SQL assertion/report showing role, transaction SiteContext and result
Screenshot + URL/Host + DOM/accessibility state where visual runtime matters
Broker delivery/attempt/DLQ/replay trace keyed by job ID
Sanitized key/state/TTL observation showing tenant namespace
Index generation/query result snapshot with site identity
Distributed trace/correlation record with secrets removed
Restore timeline, RPO/RTO calculation and post-restore integrity report
Defect record with root cause/fix/build/rerun evidence

privacy_rule: Evidence must obey DOC-19. Do not persist passwords, MFA seeds, raw reset/invitation/Preview grants, bearer/session/CSRF secrets, private object credentials, ArticleBody content when not required, or unnecessary PII.
